name: os.signal
doc:
os.signal: POSIX signals as async events (Go's os/signal):
  await signal.Wait(signal.SIGTERM)          // one delivery
  var ch = signal.Notify([signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM])
  var sig = await ch.Recv()?                  // each delivery, forever
Signals are plain ints (signal.SIGINT ...); Name(sig) gives "SIGINT".
Once a signal is waited for (or notified), its default action (e.g.
terminating on SIGINT) is replaced until Reset. Deliveries that arrive
while nobody waits are remembered (counted) and satisfy the next Wait.
Runtime: runtime/src/std_os_signal.c (self-pipe + a dedicated thread).

items.name: Catch
items.doc:
Catches sigs without waiting yet: their default action is replaced
and deliveries are counted until a Wait takes them.
items.summary: Catches sigs without waiting yet: their default action is replaced and deliveries are counted until a Wait takes them.

items.name: Ignore
items.doc: Ignores sigs (SIG_IGN) and forgets pending deliveries.
items.summary: Ignores sigs (SIG_IGN) and forgets pending deliveries.

items.name: Notify
items.doc:
A channel receiving every delivery of the given signals (buffer of
16: deliveries beyond it wait in the channel's sender).
items.summary: A channel receiving every delivery of the given signals (buffer of 16: deliveries beyond it wait in the channel's sender).

items.name: Pending
items.doc: Deliveries of sig received but not yet waited for.
items.summary: Deliveries of sig received but not yet waited for.

items.name: Raise
items.doc: Sends sig to this process (for tests and self-signalling).
items.summary: Sends sig to this process (for tests and self-signalling).

items.name: Reset
items.doc: Restores the default action of sigs.
items.summary: Restores the default action of sigs.

items.name: Wait
items.doc: Waits for the next delivery of sig.
items.summary: Waits for the next delivery of sig.

items.name: WaitAny
items.doc: Waits for the first of sigs; yields which one arrived.
